page.overview:
Who is Devexian?

Devexian, also known as "D", is an Aeormaton who the Mighty Nein found in the ruined city of Aeor. He was given the name Charlie while he couldn't remember his true designation after being found by the Mighty Nein. Later, as "D", he sold Fresh Cut Grass to Dancer. As an NPC, Devexian is played by Matthew Mercer.

Devexian is tall, masculine-presenting (and generally described as handsome), and roughly humanoid in form, made of dull, brass-like metal with intricate filigreed engraving and gold trim. He has no nose, but does have eye sockets, a mouth, and jaw, and a "deepish" voice. When the Mighty Nein found him, his legs had been heavily damaged.

In his guise as "D", Devexian passed for an organic humanoid, wearing a "really intricate metal mask" (which was actually just his face) and a dark hooded cloak. He walked alongside a crawler-pulled cart and wore leather boots., Imogen used Detect Thoughts on Imahara Joe to actually view his memory of seeing D.}}

He is serious and professional, but has a fondness for those who seek knowledge like him. He isn't used to be the center of attention.
